footer.description: This section provides access to the general provisions published in the Official Gazette. It contains references of texts published since 1897 and the full texts published since 1998.

accueil.slide1_texte: To improve its visibility and drive the Public Service reform programmes, a pillar of our country's development, <0> the Ministry of Labour, Employment and Public and Social Services </0> is working to set up a digital library.
accueil.slide2_texte: <0> The Ministry of Labour, Employment and Public Service </0> is implementing initiatives to modernise the public administration and improve the efficiency of services offered to citizens. A digital library is one of the cornerstones of these reforms.
accueil.slide3_texte: In a continuous effort to improve the transparency and accessibility of its services, <0> the Ministry </0> is working to implement digital solutions, including a digital library that will support information management and the dissemination of public resources.
accueil.slide4_texte: The digital library gives civil servants, researchers and citizens a space for exchange and documentation suited to their needs.
accueil.slide5_texte: By making knowledge and ministerial documentation easier to access, the Ministry is preparing tomorrow's skills today.

aide.intro: Answers to the most frequently asked questions about the digital library.
aide.premiere_visite: First visit? Take the guided tour of the application (30 seconds).
aide.faq1_question: How do I find a document?
aide.faq1_reponse: Open “Search” in the menu (or use the “/” or Ctrl+K shortcut). Type a keyword, a number or pick a criterion: subject, type, date, number or Official Gazette. You can also refine with the filters (type, domain, legal status) or browse by theme via “Browse by theme” in the menu.
aide.faq2_question: What do the statuses “In force”, “Repealed”, “Amended” mean?
aide.faq2_reponse: “In force”: the text is applicable as it stands. “Repealed”: the text has been officially removed and no longer applies. “Amended”: the text remains in force but has been changed by a later text — check its legal relations to see the amending texts.
aide.faq3_question: How do I access the full text of a document?
aide.faq3_reponse: From the results list, click a document to open its detailed record. You will find the plain-language summary, its references (number, date, Official Gazette) and the original PDF file, viewable and downloadable.
aide.faq4_question: How do I receive publication alerts?
aide.faq4_reponse: Go to the “Subscribe to publication alerts” section (home page or footer), enter your email address and confirm. A confirmation email will be sent to activate the subscription. You can unsubscribe at any time using the link in every email.
aide.faq5_question: How do I rate the application or leave a comment?
aide.faq5_reponse: To rate the application, use the stars in the “Rate our application” section at the bottom of the home page (one rating per browser). For a suggestion or a report, click “Comments” in the footer: your message is sent to the administrators.
aide.faq6_question: How do I contact the ministry?
aide.faq6_reponse: The official contact details (address, phone, email) of the Ministry of Labour, Employment and Public Service and Social Laws are grouped in the “Contacts” section of the footer, as well as on the Organisation page presenting the directorates and their roles.

stats.page_sous_titre: Overview: visitors, published texts and views — same data as before, presented differently.
stats.vide: No data for this period yet.
stats.visiteurs_aide_1: Each line shows a daily count, in the Madagascar time zone (midnight to midnight); the chosen period changes the figures shown.
stats.visiteurs_aide_2: “Distinct visitors” counts each person once per day; “Views” counts every page open, including repeats.
stats.visiteurs_aide_3: Hover a point (or tap it) to see the full date and the values.
stats.visiteurs_differents_aide: different people in the selected period
stats.visiteurs_courbe_aide: Each point = number of distinct visitors that day; the grey line counts all views.
stats.textes_aide_1: The total combines published texts (documents) and bodies (corps) of the library.
stats.textes_aide_2: “Additions” compares texts added today, this month and this year (bars from largest to smallest).
stats.textes_aide_3: Pick a type of text for its exact count; tables sort by clicking a header.
stats.repartition_type_aide: Choose a type to display its number of texts.
stats.textes_ajouts_aide: Comparison of texts added: today, this month and this year.
stats.corps_aide_1: The bars compare bodies added today, this month and this year.
stats.corps_aide_2: Select a body to display the exact number of texts it covers.
stats.corps_aide_3: The table ranks the most viewed bodies; click “Views” to re-sort, “Show more” for the rest.
stats.repartition_corps_aide: Choose a body to display its number of texts.
stats.corps_ajouts_aide: Comparison of bodies added: today, this month and this year.
stats.consultations_aide_1: These figures are cumulative since the library went online: they never reset.
stats.consultations_aide_2: A view = one anonymous visitor counted once per day per text (Madagascar time zone); a download = saving a file. Older totals, however, cumulate every opening.
stats.consultations_aide_3: Click a column header to sort; “Show more” reveals the rest of the ranking.
stats.consultations_courbe_aide: Each bar = number of views for a type of text, from most to least viewed.
stats.consultations_docs_aide: Documents ranked by number of views (cumulative).
